card.name: Digits inside citation page numbers and DOIs
card.fires_on: Single digits or short pieces inside page ranges, volume numbers and DOI or URL codes in reference lists. It responds partway through the number, before the range or code is finished.

modes.label: Page-range digits
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a journal page range after volume and year.

modes.label: DOI or URL codes
modes.description: A piece of a DOI or article URL code in a reference.

card.plain: It fires on the numbers inside journal citations, such as page ranges and DOI codes, in the middle of a reference.
